title: Sheinbaum: They Tried Everything to Defeat Us for Two Years; They Failed and Will Fail Again
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
content:
_This article by[Sugeyry Romina
Gándara](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/sugeyry_gandara/) originally
appeared in the [November 20, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4907008/sheinbaum-dos-anos-intentando-
todo-para-derrotarnos-fracasaron-volveran-a-fracasar/), a Mexican digital news
outlet._

_The Mexican president said that those who received money to keep quiet about
injustices and those who used to evade taxes are the same people who corrupted
the electoral bodies._

**Mexico City, November 20 (SinEmbargo).-** [**President Claudia Sheinbaum
Pardo**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/claudia-sheinbaum/) (CSP) highlighted
this Friday the failure of the opposition, which has tried to weaken her
government over the past two years, and predicted that it would fail again in
its attempt to delegitimize the **elections**.

> “Those who long to regain their prerogatives and privileges, desperate at
> their lack of popular support, are trying to weaken this project of
> transformation, which is nothing other than the Mexican people’s achievement
> of democracy and social justice. In these two years they have tried
> everything to defeat the popular will, but they have failed. They failed
> with their paid campaigns on social media and in the news media to
> manufacture lies and slander. They failed a year ago with their calls for
> violence and by inventing false youth mobilizations,” she declared during
> her speech marking the 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution.

The president also gave a historical account of the Mexican people’s struggle
for democracy, recalled the electoral frauds of 2006 and 2012, and warned that
her adversaries would not succeed in their latest attempt to discredit the
2027 electoral process.

> “They failed with the deliberate slander that this government protects
> criminals. They failed when they sought foreign interference, and let this
> be heard loud and far: they are going to fail again in their attempt to
> delegitimize the 2027 elections, because that is their new farce. Knowing
> they are defeated, they seek to sow doubts about a process that will be a
> historic example of respect for the vote. We come from the struggle against
> electoral fraud. Democracy is our essence, and we will never betray our own
> history,” she said.

![Claudia Sheinbaum stands in an open military vehicle between army and navy
officers during the Mexican Revolution
parade.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/sheinbaum-
opposition-failed-inline-1.jpg)President Claudia Sheinbaum led the parade
marking the 116th anniversary of the Mexican Revolution. Photo: Presidency.

She also recalled that those who question the Fourth Transformation today are
the same people who, she said, engaged in corrupt practices in the past.

“It is paradoxical that those who today cry out about a supposed lack of
freedom are the same people who lived comfortably during the neoliberal
period. Those who applauded the regime in exchange for privileged access to
the highest circles, those who received envelopes of money every month to
silence injustices, and those who used to evade taxes and are now forced to
comply with the rule of law are the same people who corrupted the electoral
bodies, those who divided up appointments and collected severance payments in
the millions while keeping quiet about vote buying,” she stated.

## Mexico Is Living Through a New Stage, Sheinbaum Says

In her speech, President Sheinbaum said Mexico is living through a new stage
of democracy and freedoms, in which freedom to demonstrate, freedom of
expression, freedom of the press and freedom of assembly are respected. She
maintained that people are no longer persecuted for thinking differently and
that power is no longer the privilege of a few.

She also defended her government’s austerity policy and said that luxuries and
privileges in the exercise of power had ended: “Moral authority is not
imposed; it is built through a life of consistency,” she said.

At the same time, she maintained that the attacks on her movement are carried
out because of the honesty of its members, saying: “They attack us because our
honesty gets in their way.”

Sheinbaum also referred to her recent visit to China, where, she said, it
became clear that there is another path to development, as Mexico is building
its own model.

“I am returning from an international trip where I had the high honor of
representing Mexico, and I made it very clear to the world: our nation is
demonstrating that there is another path to development, one where economic
success is measured not only in production figures but in families’ well-
being. Where investment translates into rights, and wealth into justice for
everyone. We are building our own model, forged in our cultural greatness, in
the talent of our people. We are a free, independent, democratic and sovereign
country,” she said.

She also maintained that her government is neither a mere ornament nor a tool
of the powerful figures of the past, and reaffirmed her commitment to the
people and to democracy.

“We are a government of the people and for the people. Let there be no doubt:
your president has a clear course. We will not betray, because our loyalty is
sealed with the dignity of our great people. Today I call on everyone without
distinction, on those who wish to keep marching along the path of well-being
and progress with justice. The path of democracy with justice has no turning
back. The path of sovereignty was marked out by our heroes and heroines. The
path is the people, and our destiny is to walk with the great people of
Mexico. Long live democracy,” she concluded.
